content: No single canonical 'SELECT 1 via Supabase in GH Actions' example found; synthesized from general Supabase CI/CD patterns (supabase/setup-cli@v1 action, secrets-based DATABASE_URL) plus general Postgres-client-in-CI practice. Recommendation: avoid a postgres: service container (tests generic connectivity, not the actual pooler/driver/scheme this phase must validate); instead run a small script using the exact same client module the Edge Functions use (postgres.js with prepare:false against the Transaction Pooler secret) so CI exercises the identical connection code path as production.
